name: Electronic Tiger Creative Studio
bio:
Electronic Tiger Creative Studio is an independent creative and digital media studio dedicated to transforming ideas into original brands, intellectual properties, and immersive creative experiences.

At the intersection of creativity, storytelling, education, and emerging technologies, we develop distinctive creative projects that entertain, educate, inspire, and connect with audiences across generations.

From children's educational entertainment and personal development media to cinematic AI filmmaking, our work spans multiple creative industries, each with its own identity, vision, and purpose.

Our creative portfolio includes Noah & Inna™, an Islamic children's educational and entertainment brand; The Evan AI, a personal development and educational media brand; and OAFS — Obsidian AI Films Studio, a cinematic AI filmmaking and storytelling brand.

Each creation represents a different expression of our creative vision, united by one philosophy: meaningful ideas deserve to become extraordinary creations.

We embrace the possibilities of artificial intelligence, digital innovation, and modern creative technologies to expand what can be imagined, developed, and brought to life.

Our ambition goes beyond producing content. We aim to build enduring creative brands, develop original intellectual properties, and establish a growing portfolio of distinctive digital creations with the potential to reach audiences worldwide.

We don't just create content. We build brands, stories, and ideas that have the power to endure.
tagline: IDEAS INTO CREATIONS. CREATIVITY WITHOUT BOUNDARIES.

projects.title: Noah & Inna™
projects.description:
Raising Future Muslim Leaders Through Faith, Character & Life Skills.

Noah & Inna™ is an Islamic children's educational and entertainment brand dedicated to nurturing the next generation of confident, compassionate, knowledgeable, and responsible Muslim children.

Through engaging Islamic songs, nursery rhymes, animated stories, and educational adventures, we make learning meaningful, joyful, and accessible for children aged 2–7.

Every song, story, and adventure is designed to help children develop positive habits, strong values, essential life skills, and a lifelong love of learning — all rooted in Islamic values.

We believe that raising future Muslim leaders begins in early childhood, through the little lessons, everyday habits, and meaningful experiences that shape who they become.

Noah & Inna™ — Learn. Grow. Serve. With Allah at the center of every step.

projects.title: The Evan AI
projects.description:
Helping You Become More Capable, Confident & Intentional.

The Evan AI is a personal development and educational media brand dedicated to helping people navigate life, discover their potential, and build a better future.

Through practical insights on psychology, human behavior, identity, habits, career, financial growth, ambition, and personal development, we explore how ordinary people can become more capable and take greater control of their lives.

Our mission is to make personal growth practical, accessible, and actionable — helping people overcome setbacks, develop valuable skills, build confidence, and make better decisions.

We believe you don't need to have everything figured out to move forward. You just need to keep learning, growing, and becoming better, one step at a time.

The Evan AI — Keep Building, There's More To Learn.

Evan is an AI-created host.

projects.title: OAFS — Obsidian AI Films Studio
projects.description:
Where AI Creates. Stories Endure.

OAFS (Obsidian AI Films Studio) is an AI-powered filmmaking and creative storytelling studio dedicated to producing immersive cinematic experiences that explore human nature, relationships, power, secrets, and the complexities of life.

Through AI-driven filmmaking, we bring compelling stories to life across crime, mystery, psychological suspense, family drama, and emotional storytelling.

Our productions explore the darker sides of human nature, the consequences of choices, hidden truths, ambition, betrayal, and the emotional connections that define us.

We believe powerful storytelling goes beyond entertainment. It challenges perspectives, evokes emotions, sparks curiosity, and creates experiences that stay with audiences long after the screen fades to black.

From original cinematic short films to immersive AI-generated movie experiences, OAFS combines creative vision, technology, and storytelling to push the boundaries of digital filmmaking.

OAFS — Where AI Creates. Stories Endure.
